issues.description: Lesson 1 Consolidation paragraph ends mid-quote and is truncated mid-sentence: 'STRATEGY COMPARE + LOOK AHEAD: invite TWO pairs who used DIFFERENT rules on the SAME objects, ask why did you get different…'. The text is cut off before the question mark and closing quote, leaving the slide ending on an ellipsis.
issues.suggested_fix: Shorten the Lesson 1 consolidation strategy_compare_text in the JSON so the full sentence fits within the slide's text box, or split the consolidation across two paragraphs to avoid mid-sentence truncation.

issues.description: Worksheet 1 'Detective Dot's First Case' (a sorting activity for D1.1) shows a wrong-unit phonics asset titled 'Sound Boxes' with the words PIN, CUP, RUN, LID and empty 3-cell sound boxes. This is a phonics worksheet template that has nothing to do with sorting objects by attribute.
issues.suggested_fix: Replace the embedded Sound Boxes asset on Worksheet 1 with a sorting-appropriate visual (e.g. an array of mixed shape/colour tokens for children to circle by rule, or two sort-bin frames). Update the worksheet composer mapping for g1_data_detectives Worksheet 1 so it does not pull a phonics M3_LETTERS asset.

issues.description: Worksheet 1 instructions are nonsensical for a Lesson 1 sorting activity: '1. Look at the pile. 2. Same pile as Part 1. 3. Pick a rule.' Step 2 references a 'Part 1' that is not visible on the worksheet, and the instructions do not direct children to actually sort or label a rule.
issues.suggested_fix: Rewrite Worksheet 1 student instructions to match the sorting task, e.g. '1. Look at the objects. 2. Pick ONE rule (colour, shape, or size). 3. Circle the objects that follow your rule and write the rule on the line.'

issues.description: Worksheet 3 'Detective Dot's Pictograph' instructions do not match a pictograph-building task: '1. Look at the pictograph. 2. The tally chart shows 4 categories. 3. Survey your family at home.' Step 2 is a declarative statement instead of a directive, and step 3 sends the work home rather than directing in-class pictograph building.
issues.suggested_fix: Rewrite Worksheet 3 instructions to be directive and pictograph-focused, e.g. '1. Pick a class survey question. 2. Draw ONE picture per child in the matching row. 3. Add a title and a label for each row.'

issues.description: Worksheet 5 'Detective Dot's Final Case' (the capstone) renders only a single 'My Capstone Tally' table; the four capstone stations (sort, tally, pictograph, ordering/conclusion) are not visible. Instructions reference building a pictograph but the page has no pictograph grid, no ordering area, and no conclusion line.
issues.suggested_fix: Either swap the embedded asset on Worksheet 5 to the M6 Detective Case Template (which does have all 5 sections) or extend the worksheet to span the four capstone stations so children can complete tally, pictograph, ordering, and conclusion in order on the same sheet.

issues.description: Summative Assessment Rubric cells truncate Level descriptors mid-sentence with ellipsis on D1.1, D1.2, D1.4, and D1.5 rows (e.g. 'explains how the rule changes…', 'articulates why…', 'orders all categories…'). Cell heights are not tall enough to show full descriptors.
issues.suggested_fix: Either shorten the rubric Level descriptors so each fits the cell, or increase rubric cell height / split the rubric across two slides so descriptors render in full without trailing ellipsis.

summary: 5 blocking issues. Lesson 1 consolidation truncates mid-quote (s3). Worksheet 1 (s8) embeds a wrong-unit Sound Boxes phonics asset and ships nonsensical instructions. Worksheet 3 (s10) instructions do not match a pictograph build. Worksheet 5 capstone (s12) only renders the tally section, missing pictograph/ordering/conclusion stations. Rubric (s25) truncates Level descriptors (minor). Puppets and manipulatives render cleanly. Routed revise_content; dominant issue is content/instructions across worksheets and lesson scripts.
